nutrition.source: USDA National Nutrient Database for Standard Reference, Release 28 (2015), as hosted by USDA ARS
nutrition.method: Read FOOD_DES.txt and NUT_DATA.txt directly from official ZIP. Values per 100g edible portion. Quinoa and buckwheat are dry weights, tofu raw firm calcium-set, soy sauce low-sodium shoyu. Nutrient keys use code mapping below. Missing values retained as null and listed in missingNutrients; not imputed as zero.
caveats: Tofu calcium strongly depends on coagulant; the supplied ingredient explicitly names calcium sulfate. Do not apply the 683mg/100g calcium value to all tofu products.
SR28 raw quinoa record 20035 reports DHA=0.047g/100g; retained the published number despite being unusual.
Original app coerces absent n values to zero in sums. Render nutritionNote (or equivalent warning) so partial totals are not mistaken for complete measurements.

validation: Six unique IDs: R11-R13,V11-V13, no collision with original 30 recipes.
All batch ingredient references resolve; all group indexes are valid and amounts positive.
Every ingredient amount is whole-family raw/dry/edible weight, using existing 55:33:12 allocation. No per-person extras or exclusions.
All six include primary source title,url,note and ingredient-accurate image prompt.
All six recipe bodies were independently worded; no verbatim publisher passages; derived recipe wording per publisher page is under 200 words.
New ingredients parsed from official USDA data, all required n keys present; missing source values explicitly null.
